title: Analysis differential benchmark scalability / integrity hardening

portable_runtime.note: Portable evaluator-only harness. Not an iPhone, real-audio, or current-Moises differential measurement.

semantic_regression.note: W16 intentionally preserves prior greedy-nearest metric semantics instead of silently switching to maximum-cardinality matching.

complexity_model.w16_one_to_one_matcher: sort timestamps + binary-search predecessor/successor + union-find deletion
complexity_model.w16_nearest_error: sort target + binary-search nearest per source timestamp
complexity_model.claim_boundary: Operation-count model only; not a device CPU speedup ratio.

evaluator_cardinality_policy.behavior: Reference or estimate cardinality beyond the duration-aware limit fails the affected evidence row closed and parity_eligible becomes false. No silent truncation is used to manufacture an accuracy score.
evaluator_cardinality_policy.stress_note: The 100,000-beat and 16,384-boundary portable helper stresses intentionally exercise matcher scalability beyond many normal-duration evaluator limits; active product evidence evaluates the cardinality gate before metric matching.

all_rows: W15 snapshot beat/chord/section input counts and limits
structure_row_additional: W14 section count before/after boundary hardening

compile_variance_note: A separate unoptimized Swift 6.2.1 recompile of the matcher also passed 2000/2000 semantic Oracle cases and the adversarial case; its 100,000-beat elapsed time was approximately 0.1306 seconds. Timing is therefore recorded only with build-context labels and is not treated as a device guarantee.
limitations: No rights-cleared multi-genre real audio was available in this Worker wave.
No current-iPhone Moises differential was executed.
No physical-iPhone CPU, memory, thermal, battery, or cancellation measurement was executed.
Full canonical SwiftPM/Xcode execution remains an HQ integrated-checkout gate.
Legacy AnalysisRealAudioBenchmarkRunner.run remains for compatibility only; new differential evidence must use runProductAligned.
